summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of HOME OS Phase 2 Arena module and PWA features completed. Tested 4 KPI cards in 2x2 grid, Card 4 expansion with Growth Nebula SVG chart, LIVE FUNNEL PULSE terminal with 6-second event timing, localStorage persistence, PWA manifest/service worker, navigation, and CSS compliance. All 18 required features passed successfully.
passed_tests: Arena module displays 4 KPI cards in perfect 2x2 grid layout
KPI values correct: Lead Velocity (42), Conversion Efficiency (2.4%), Customer LTV ($34.50), Monthly Net Profit ($4,200)
Fonts implemented correctly: Orbitron for titles, JetBrains Mono for values
Card 4 (Monthly Net Profit) has expand icon and is clickable
Card 4 expands to full-width showing Growth Nebula SVG chart
Growth Nebula chart displays lime green 2px line with data points
Dashed target line visible at $15k in Growth Nebula chart
Card 4 collapse functionality working (expand/collapse icons change ▼ ↔ ▲)
LIVE FUNNEL PULSE terminal positioned below KPI grid
Funnel Pulse adds new event every 6 seconds automatically
Funnel events have correct structure: timestamp [HH:MM], event type (green), detail, optional amount
Maximum 10 events maintained in funnel feed
Arena data persists correctly in localStorage under homeOS.arena key
Navigation to NODE, SANCTUM, ORACLE modules shows placeholder content
Returning to Arena re-mounts full dashboard and restarts funnel pulse
PWA manifest.json accessible at /manifest.json with display:standalone and orientation:landscape
Service worker accessible at /service-worker.js with offline caching capabilities
VIRGIL message bar shows contextual Arena-specific messages
CSS compliance perfect: NO box-shadow, text-shadow, backdrop-filter, or gradients found
Color scheme compliance: #0a0a0a background, #141414 cards, #32CD32 accent, #333 borders
Wellbeing overlay time-based trigger system working correctly

success_percentage.backend: N/A (No backend APIs - pure localStorage/Vanilla JS app)
